paite: Huan zawlneite tapate' zite lak a numei khat in Elisha kiang ah, "Na sikha, ka pasal ana sita hi. Na sikha in TOUPA alau chih na thei a; aleibatna pa'n ka tate anih ua sikha dia pi ding in ahong kuan hi," chi in amangbat thu ahilh hi.
heading: Elisha In Meithai Genthei Apanpih

paite: Elisha in akiang ah, "Bang ka hon hihsak dia? Hon hilh ve, inn ah bang na nei a?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikhanu'n sathau um khat kia lou ngal inn ah bangmah ka nei kei," achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Va kuan inla, na invengte tengteng bel vuak va khelkhawm in; tam lou kia zaw khel ke'n.
Na hong lut chiang in na tapate toh kong kikhakkhum unla, huai tuh tengteng ah sathau thun inla; adimdim in na tuamkoih ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in akiang a pan apaita a, amah leh atapate toh kong akikhakkhum ua; amau belte ahon la ua, ama'n ana thun zel hi.
Belte adim nung in, hichi ahong hi a, atapa kiang ah, "Bel hon la nawn dih," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Bel a-om nawn kei," achi hi. Huchi in sathau akangta hi.
Huai khit in Pathian mipa kiang ah ava hoh a, thil omdan ava hilh hi. Ama'n, "Va pai inla, sathau va zuak inla, na leibat va din inla, aval in na tapate toh khosa un,” achi hi.
Ni khat Shunem ah Elisha ava zin hi. Huai ah numei neizoutak khat a-om hi. Ama'n an ne ding in ana sawl teitei hi. Huchi in apai peuhmah chiang in huai ah an ne ding in alut hi.
heading: Elisha Leh Shunem A Pan Numei Hausa

paite: Ama'n apasal kiang ah, “Ngai in, hiai mi hon nawk zelpa Pathian misiangthoupa ahi, chih ka thei.
Kisa dih, inn pindan neu i bawlsak dia, lupna, dohkan, tutphah leh khawnvak koihna i koihsak ding. Huchi a i kiang a ahong chiang in alut zel ding,” achi hi.
Ni khat ava hoh a, huai in pindan ah ava lut a, ava lum hi.
Asikha Gehazi kiang ah, "Hiai Shunem numei hon sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a ama ah ahong dingh hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, nang nakpitak in na hon deihthoh a, bang ka hon hihsak sam dia, kumpipa hiam, sepaih heutu hiam hon houpihsak leng na ut hia? chi in akiang ah gen in," achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Ка chipihte lak mah a teng ka hi," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Amah a dia bang hih ding ahia le?" achi hi. Gehazi in adawng a, "Tapa anei kei, apasal lah a-upata a," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Va sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a, kong ah ahong dingh hi.
Ama'n, "Tu bang hun ahong tun nawn chiang in tapa na pomta ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Maizen, toupa, nang Pathian mipa in na sikhanu kiang ah zuaugen ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in numei agai a, Elisha in akiang a, agen bang a ahun ahong tun nawn in tapa aneita hi.
Naungek ahong khanglian a, ni khat apa toh buh la mite kiang ah akuan hi.
Apa kiang ah, "Ka lu, ka lu," achi hi. Apa'n sikha valnou khat kiang ah, "Pom inla, anu kiang ah paipih in," achi hi.
Apaipih a, anu kiang atun in aphei tung ah sun tan atu a, huchi in asita hi.
Apaitou a, Pathian mipa lupna ah asial a, kong akhakkhum a, apawtta hi.
Huchi in apasal asam a, "Sikha kuahiam leh sabiltung khat hon ngaihtuahsak dih ve, Pathian mipa kiang ah ka va tai dia, ka hong kik nawn ding,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Bangziak a tuni chitchiat a akiang a hoh tum na hia? Kha thak leng ahi kei a, Sabbath leng ahi ngal kei a," achi hi. Ama'n, “Ahoih ding," achi hi.
Huchi in sabiltung abawl a, asikha kiang ah, "Hawl inla malam ah pai in, thu ka hon piak keileh awl pai ke'n," achi hi.
Huchi in apaita a, Pathian mipa kiang ah Karmel tang ah ava hoh hi. Pathian mipa'n gamlapi a pan ana muh in, hichi ahong hi a, asikha Gehazi kiang ah, "En in, huai ah Shunem numei a-om.
Amah dawn ding in va tai inla, akiang ah, na dam hia? Na pasal adam maw? Naupang leng adam maw? va chi in,” achi hi. Ama'n ana dawng a, "Dam e," achi hi.

Mual a Pathian mipa kiang ava tun in, akhe alen tinten a, amah hong sawnhang tum in Gehazi in ava naih hi. Himahleh Pathian mipa'n, "Bangmah chih ke'n, alungsim mangbang ahi. TOUPA'N ka lak ah asel a, ahon hilh nai kei hi,” achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Ka toupa, tapa ka hon ngen a hia? Hon khem ke'n, ka hon chi hilou maw?" achi hi.

Huchi in Gehazi kiang ah, "Na puan teng inla, ka chiangkhun tawi in va hoh in. Kuapeuh mu lechin leng, chibai buk ke'n. Kuapeuh in chibai ahon buk uleh leng dawng ke'n. Naupang maitang ah ka chiangkhun va nga in," achi hi.
Naupang nu'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, ka hon khah het kei ding,” achi hi. Huchi in athou a, azuita hi.
Gehazi in amau ana makhelh a, naupang mai ah chiangkhun ana nga hi. Himahleh aw leh zak bangmah a-om kei. Huchi in houpih ding in akik nawn a, "Naupang hak het kei veh aw," chi in ahilh hi.
Elisha insung ava lutleh ngai in, naupang asi khinta a, alupna ah ana lumsak lai uhi.
Huchi in ava lut a, anih un kong akhakkhum a, TOUPA kiang ah athum hi.
Apaitou a, naupang abohkhum a, amuk leh amuk, amit leh amit, akhut leh akhut asutuah a; atung ah akizan a; huchi in naupang taksa ahong lum hiaihiai hi.
Huchi in akik nawn a, insung ah akivialleh a; ahohtou a, atung ah abok a; huchi in naupang sagihvei ahong hahchiai a, ahong hakta hi.
Huchi in Gehazi asam a, "Hiai Shunem numei hon sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a, akiang a ava lutleh, "Na tapa pom in," ana chi hi.
Huchi in ava lut a, akhebul ah abokkhup a, amai a lei si in akun a; atapa apom a, apawtkhia hi.
Gilgal ah Elisha ahoh nawn hi. Huai gam ah kial akia hi. Zawlneite tapate ama ah atukhawm ua; ama'n asikha kiang ah, "Bel lianpi suang inla, zawlneite tapate an huansak in," achi hi.
heading: Thillamdang Om Lai Nihte

paite: Mi khat gam ah meh zong in ava kuan a, gam khau ava mu a, agah khenkhat alou a, apuan in atun theih zah atun a, a-atnen a, bel sung ah akha hi. Bang ahia chih athei kuamah a-om kei uh.
Huchi in huai mite nek ding in asuakkhia ua, anhuan anek ualeh, hichi ahong hi a, "Ehe, Pathian mi, bel sung a sihna om akei maw,” achi kheukhou ua; ane theita kei uh.
Ama'n, "Tangbuang hon la dih ua,” achi a; huai tuh ah akha hi, “Mite nek ding in hon suakkhe dih ua,” achi hi. Huchi in bel ah lauhuai bangmah a-omta kei hi.
Baal-shalisha a pan mi khat ahong a, Pathian mipa a ding in buh thak masapen abawl barli buh sangpek sawmnih leh buh thak vui a-ip in ahon tawi a; ama'n, "Hiai mite nek ding in pia in," achi hi.
Asikha in, "Bang e, mi zakhattak hiai ka lui ding maw?" achi hi. Ama'n hiai mite nek ding pia in. TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ane ding ua, akhamval lai ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in alui a, ane ua, TOUPA chih bang ngei in akhamval lai uhi.
